title: Nutrition evidence extraction record
description: One structured record per paper, produced by the full-corpus per-study extraction stage (prompts/extraction_prompt.md; code/21_build_extraction_inputs.py -> extraction workflow -> code/22_merge_evidence_db.py). The file data/evidence_db.json is an array of these records. Every field is grounded ONLY in the source paper; unstated fields take the empty/null value.

study_design.description: VERBATIM from publication_type + journal, e.g. 'Meta-analysis', 'Systematic review & meta-analysis', 'Cochrane review', 'RCT', 'Non-randomised trial', 'Cohort', 'Case-control', 'Cross-sectional', 'Modeling study', 'Narrative/other review', 'Guideline', 'Other'. Only 'Cochrane review' when journal is the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews.

intervention_category.description: Controlled tag or 'other:<label>'. Controlled vocab: vitamin_a, zinc, iron_children, mnp, sq_lns, multiple_micronutrient_children, anc_mmn, ifa_antenatal, folic_acid_periconception, bep_pregnancy, calcium_pregnancy, maternal_nutrition_other, food_fortification, iodine, complementary_feeding, breastfeeding, cmam_sam_mam, wash, cash_transfers, social_protection, deworming, school_feeding, growth_monitoring, nutrition_sensitive_ag, multisectoral, delayed_cord_clamping, vitamin_d_children.

comparator.description: Control / placebo / standard care / none stated.

lmic.description: Evaluated in low/middle-income or global settings.

outcomes.description: Up to ~6 most important effect estimates (all-cause and cause-specific as SEPARATE rows; fixed and random effects as separate rows).

dominant_trial.description: Evidence-graph field: the heaviest-weight trial named by the review (e.g. DEVTA for vitamin A). Empty if none stated.

included_trials.description: Evidence-graph field: primary trials named in a review's included-studies list / forest plots (NCT/ISRCTN or 'Author Year'). Empty for abstract-only or non-reviews.

on_topic.description: True if a nutrition / nutrition-sensitive intervention for under-5 or WRA in LMIC/global settings.

fulltext_used.description: Whether full text (vs abstract only) informed the record.

notes.description: Caveats: superseded version, trial overlap, underpowered pathway, reclassification, etc.

value.description: Point estimate; null if not stated.

subgroup.description: e.g. 'fixed-effect', 'random-effect', an age band, a certainty grade.

direction.description: Direction of effect. 'null' = no significant effect.

note.description: Optional free-text annotation for this specific outcome row.
